en: A sepia-toned street scene in a European city, showing a steep cobblestone street lined with multi‑story brick buildings that have many metal balconies. Horse‑drawn carts stand on the right side of the street. Various shop signs hang from the buildings. On the right, one sign clearly reads "Carl J. Olsson Kött Fläsk Charkuteri." The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century urban neighborhood.
